dimensions.assessment: Directly involves the Montgomery County Land Bank and the Department of Veterans Affairs, affecting future military families and veterans utilizing the Dayton National Cemetery.
dimensions.evidence: enter into an agreement with the Montgomery County Land Bank for the transfer of certain land near Dayton National Cemetery

dimensions.assessment: Involves a specific local property acquisition of approximately 58 acres at no cost for cemetery expansion.
dimensions.evidence: approximately 58 acres of land located in Dayton, Ohio, across from Dayton National Cemetery

dimensions.assessment: The land transfer is explicitly conducted at no cost and for no consideration to the Department.
dimensions.evidence: at no cost of the land to the Department and for no consideration

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes a single administrative land transaction and cemetery expansion project rather than broader statutory changes.
dimensions.evidence: Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall begin the process of entering into an agreement with the Land Bank to carry out such transfer

dimensions.assessment: Provides a permanent addition of land to the national cemetery infrastructure, though the transactional process is one-time.
dimensions.evidence: use such parcel as a national cemetery

missing_information: The exact development and ongoing maintenance costs associated with turning the acquired land into an active cemetery expansion are not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes the transfer of approximately 58 acres of land in Dayton, Ohio, to the VA for expanding a national cemetery.

card.summary: H.R. 8800 sets national defense authorizations for Fiscal Year 2027, addressing military personnel, benefits, health care, acquisition policies, military construction projects, Department of Energy national security programs, and maritime administration activities. It also includes the 'SAVE America Act', which alters federal election voting requirements.
